items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: How do you like Louise playing? Crazy about it. Crazy. Were you always crazy about it? Yeah I'd stand on the boat before I did and say let's stand on the boat, let's make them play, and I'd play like that.

ctx.x: You know there's nothing wrong with me, it shouldn't be very good.
It takes a little more than no arm struggle. How do you like Louise playing? Crazy about it. Crazy. Were you always crazy about it?
Yeah I'd stand on the boat before I did and say let's stand on the boat, let's make them play, and I'd play like that.
